messages:
ana: Emergency hotfix ready for a regression where poorly-formed streaming tokens caused tail-end 502s in eu-central. Patch is tiny (2.6.3-hotfix): tokenizer bounds + guard. No client or DB changes. Requesting rapid 00:45-01:15 UTC surge window. Plan: smoke -> 1% canary -> 20% -> 100% (fast ramp with checks). Auto-rollback criteria: 5xx > 0.25% for 2m OR streaming disconnects spike > 2x baseline in 1m. Will pin dedicated pools to 2.6.2 during canary.

deploy-bot: Deploy request submitted by @ana
- image: `redwood/serving:2.6.3-hotfix`
- targets: eu-central,multi-tenant-pool
- strategy: staged canary (1% -> 20% -> 100%)
- smoke job: `smoke/streaming-tail` (stream session 800 tokens)
- rollback-probe: `5xx>0.25||stream_disconnects>2x`

carl: Can we confirm dedicated tenants are excluded from the canary? We should pin them until verified.

ana: yes, dedicated pools pinned to 2.6.2 during rollout. I'll add the pin command to the PR.

yvonne: I can give expedited approval if ops oncall is watching and the rollback webhook is wired. ops-bot: page oncall.

ops-bot: Paging oncall: @priya (high)  please ack within 5m to avoid auto-escalation.

priya: ack. I'll monitor streaming metrics and be ready to trigger rollback.

carl: add a short release-note blurb and runbook link please. Also include the emergency-contact for support.

ana: release note: "2.6.3-hotfix: fix streaming tail 502s caused by malformed token sequences. No client changes." runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/streaming-502-fix. Emergency contact: #support-hotfixes.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 3321007800 -> starting smoke. CLI preview:

```
/deploy --image redwood/serving:2.6.3-hotfix \
  --targets eu-central,multi-tenant-pool \
  --strategy canary --canary-percent 1 --canary-duration 5m \
  --follow-up "20% in 5m if green, 100% in 10m" \
  --smoke smoke/streaming-tail --rollback-probe "5xx>0.25||stream_disconnects>2x" \
  --pin-dedicated "redwood/serving:2.6.2"
```

ana: starting smoke now, will update in ~90s.

(90s later)
ana: smoke passed; no stream disconnects, p95 stable. kicking 1% canary.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 1% at 3321007845. Observability hooks active.

priya: watching streaming dashboards and traces. all clear so far.

carl: :+1: from me for ramp to 20% after 5m if no anomalies.

(6m later)
ana: ramping to 20% now per expedited consent. will monitor for 10m before final ramp.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 20% complete at 3321007920.

yvonne: metrics look good, no spike in disconnects or errors. approve ramp to 100% in 5m.

(5m later)
ana: ramping to 100%. note: dedicated pools remain pinned to 2.6.2; once stable we'll unpin and update PR.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 100% complete at 3321008040. Monitoring window active for 30m.

priya: post-ramp checks stable. no rollback needed. I'll keep a 30m watch and then handoff to oncall rotation.

carl: thanks. ana please add post-deploy summary, unpin steps, and tag support with links to traces.

ana: will add post-deploy note + unpin instructions to the release PR and close window after 30m. thanks everyone for the quick approvals :rocket:
